input.question: Defend the Spend review of pr-015: please itemize the lab supplies and publication costs in this request with vendors and dates, and confirm each was allocable to R21AI182745 and placed before the project end date.

grant.title: Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity

purchases.item: Open-access publication fee, J. Appl. Microb. Methods

leftOut.why: Ordered in this period but not invoiced yet, so not spent.

answer.answer: Payment request pr-015 (period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30) for R21AI182745 claims two purchases. Lab supplies: rq-033, Agar plates, 40 packs, from MicroMedia, ordered 2026-04-14, $1,180, for the aim Assay validation runs (invoice paid, received 2026-04-20). Publication costs: rq-035, Open-access publication fee, J. Appl. Microb. Methods, from J. Appl. Microb. Methods, ordered 2026-04-24, $2,100, for the aim Publishing the beta-lactam assay paper (invoice paid, received 2026-04-30). Allocability: each was ordered on and charged to R21AI182745 for the research aim named with it, which makes it allocable to this grant. Timing: the project end date is 2026-08-31, and both orders (2026-04-14 and 2026-04-24) were placed before it. Totals: purchases $3,280 and personnel $5,130 make up the $8,410 total. Personnel rows are pay-R21-2026-04-1 (Research technician, 60% effort, $2,880) and pay-R21-2026-04-2 (Graduate researcher, 50% effort, $2,250). One item, rq-034 (Orbital plate shaker, $6,200), was left out of this request because it was ordered in this period but not invoiced yet, so it was not spent.
